headline: Pakistan Stock Exchange Benchmark Index Gains 1,200 Points in Early Trading
summary: Buying returned to the Pakistan Stock Exchange as the KSE-100 Index surged 1,191.19 points, or 0.68%, to reach 177,485.52. Gains were led by commercial banks, cement, auto, and oil exploration sectors.
why: The KSE-100 is the primary equity index tracking large-cap companies listed in Pakistan.

impacts.name: KSE-100
impacts.why: Broad-based buying across major sectors lifted the index by nearly 1,200 points.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Fresh buying interest across blue-chip banking and energy stocks drove a sharp morning rally.
